title: Adopt jmap_server::bool_arg / take_bool_arg in chat/contacts/metadata/tasks-server
description:
Follow-up to bd:JMAP-ic0j.39 which added bool_arg / take_bool_arg to jmap-server::helpers and adopted them in the canonical mail-server (~21 sites) and calendars-server (~7 sites).

The remaining extension-server siblings still use the inline chained form
    args.{get|remove}(K).and_then(|v| v.as_bool()).unwrap_or(default)

Site counts at the time JMAP-ic0j.39 closed:
  - jmap-chat-server: ~16 sites across chat.rs (2), contact.rs (2), emoji.rs (2), memory.rs (1), message.rs (5), space.rs (4)
  - jmap-contacts-server: ~2 sites across addressbook.rs (1), card.rs (1)
  - jmap-metadata-server: ~1 site in memory.rs
  - jmap-tasks-server: ~5 sites across memory.rs (2), task_list.rs (1), task.rs (2)

For each site:
1. Determine whether it reads .get (use bool_arg) or .remove (use take_bool_arg).
2. Confirm the read is against a Map<String, Value> args envelope, NOT against a Value-shaped inner JSON object (which would need a different helper signature — those are excluded by design).
3. Import jmap_server::bool_arg or jmap_server::take_bool_arg.
4. Replace the chained pattern with the single-line helper call.

Per-crate gates after the sweep:
  cargo fmt --all
  cargo clippy -p jmap-<crate>-server --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings
  cargo test -p jmap-<crate>-server --all-features
  RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc -p jmap-<crate>-server --no-deps --all-features

Workspace gate at the end:
  cargo test --workspace --all-features

Out of scope: helper-shape changes (the helper API is settled by JMAP-ic0j.39). Anything else stays in-scope per the bead body.
